channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's wins center on private capital commitments: BlueSky San Juan's $54M private aviation terminal at Luis Muñoz Marín, San Juan Cruise Port's $192M in accumulated investment, Warmkraft's $16M, 56-job defense-textile facility in Mayagüez, and the $163.7M Vanderbilt Residences condo-hotel filing. Federal money continued to land, including a $22M DHS facility in Ponce, $13.3M in HHS awards, and EDA/DDEC-backed life-science lab capacity at UPR. The Senate's 17-8 passage of the permitting reform is the key climate signal, though it still faces House hearings. Real risks are energy cost and reliability (a 33 cents/kWh rate, an estimated $218M quarterly added cost, and LNG supply disruptions) and soft macro readings, with the IMF projecting a 0.1% contraction in 2026 even as local indicators rebounded for a third month.
